text: 三季度单季亏损450.59亿元！资本市场回调冲击中国人寿利润表 多份研报预计，受权益市场回调影响，上市险企第三季度单季业绩承压。
text_en: A single-quarter loss of 45.059 billion yuan in Q3! Capital market pullback hits China Life's income statement. Multiple research reports expect that, affected by the equity market pullback, listed insurers' single-quarter performance in Q3 will come under pressure.
